blocks.text: System Testing is a higher level of testing where the entire software system is tested as a whole. At this stage, the software is treated as a complete entity, and testers evaluate its overall functionality, performance, security, and compliance with specified requirements. System testing involves testing the software in an environment that closely resembles the production environment to ensure that it functions correctly under real-world conditions. This level of testing helps identify defects that may arise from the interaction of various system components and verifies that the software meets its intended purpose.
